semiconductor_relevance: High — Carl Zeiss provides advanced microscopy and analysis solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Carl Zeiss is a leading manufacturer of optical, electron, and X-ray microscopes, offering advanced semiconductor analysis solutions. Their products include field emission scanning electron microscopes (FE-SEM) and focused ion beam scanning electron microscopes (FIB-SEM), which are essential for non-destructive testing and high-throughput sample preparation in semiconductor laboratories.
capabilities: Focused ion beam scanning electron microscopes (FIB-SEM)
Versa XRM X-ray microscope for non-destructive testing
Automated TEM thin film sample preparation platform
